reason: The hypothesis synthesizes findings from multiple papers on edge dislocation dominance and lattice distortion in BCC HEAs (P7, P10, P24, P34, P35) and applies them to a specific new alloy (WTaTiVZr) with a proposed mechanism linking atomic size mismatch and short-range order to a broad distribution of local lattice distortions that lowers barriers for both screw and edge dislocations. This integration of separate observations into a single mechanistic framework for a different alloy system, along with a detailed falsification test, goes beyond any single passage.
